Redoing your window screens is like dead simple!

Run down to Lowe’s / Home Depot and get:

  1. The mesh - I got a roll of the fiber glass stuff $17

  2. The pizza cutter thingy - just spend the $4 !

  3. Get the rubber spline cord - I got 100’ for $9, I had a sample of the old stuff and just eye balled the diameter. Just buy new shit ok! Your life is worth more than $9!

I did normal size windows and I figure I have enough material left over for 4 more windows at least.

Yes, buy the pizza roller. The cheap ass $4 is more than enough unless you plan to do this as a part time job.

Yes, but the rubber spline cord. I had the original plastic grooves stuff and trying to reuse that would have driven me insane!

This is easy as fuck to do folks! Even your wife can do it!

  1. Pull off the old saggy crap.

  2. Over cut the screen by at least 2”. Go 3” because you’ll be able to pull it easier. I used kitch shears to cut the mesh from the roll. Just like Christmas wrapping boys!

  3. I did use the roller onside to give me a start.

  4. I cut a line to the corner to prevent bunching. It also helps when you trim.

  5. Roughly measure out the spline cord. The shit is cheap so measure around the outside of the frame and give yourself an inch or 2.

  6. Start on the first corner. I had cut the mesh a bit so the spline fit in snuggly. Use a flat head screw drive to push it into place.

  7. Take the pizza roller and firmly gonthe length of one side, I was gong 4-5” at a time. Nice and smooth and firm. Don’t roll back and forth!!!

  8. Get to the corner, use screw driver and go up the next side.

  9. Side 3 is where I pulled the mesh and went a little slower. I also only went 2-3” to make sure that I had the mesh taunt. This side makes or breaks your install. Keep it tight boys!

  10. Finish up on the last side and pull as much as you can to get any extra material. You won’t get much.

  11. Use a cutter / razor to trim excess material. I had a cheap 4 set cutters and they handled this like a champ. Make sure your blade is sharp so snap one section off.

Things to be careful of:

I did fuck up my second screen. I had wrinkles on side 3 and thought I could reset the mesh. Well, the cheap fiber glass mesh didn’t like that and had cut like areas. So I had to redo the whole mesh. Only 1 fuckup and this was my first time to ever do this.

Really, don’t roll back and forth. Even that cheap plastic roller will probably cut through the fiber glass mesh. So, just go slow and steady.

I did this on the dinning room table and my results looked better than what I had going on.

Would I try aluminum style mesh? Nope! Don’t wanna fuck around with that hassle.

Anyway to save money? Yeah, measure out what you need and get sizes that don’t waste material. Like I said I probably have enough for 2-4 more screens. But shit dudes, I spent around 30 bucks, have extra and this only took what ??? 2 hours total. That includes shopping and a pulling the screens off the windows and cleanup.

Is this really a Christmas present? Sure it is! If your wife buys you tools you can refurbish the screens! Fair is fair guys!
